chapter: Riverboat to New Orleans and Horace Henderson
title: Why William Granger never pursued a career
summary: Granger improvised better than Jones but lacked the initiative to push ahead and take a chance.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young

blocks.x: That's what I wanted to ask you. Well, first of all, could Granger improvise too?
Better than I could, yeah, sure.
Well, you see, some guys don't have that initiative, you know, to pursue something, you know.
To go out there and go ahead, you know. You know, go ahead and get it.
Or take a chance, you know.
